title: Number of Atoms
description: Parse a chemical formula and return the count of each atom in sorted order.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize an empty stack of maps
2. Iterate through formula, parsing elements, numbers, or parentheses
3. Push/Pop maps based on parentheses and multiply counts
4. Merge all counts into a final map
5. Sort keys and format result string

steps.note: Initialize empty stack with an empty count map
Parse 'H', found atom, add to current map
Parse 'O', found atom, add to current map
Sort keys and format output: H2O
